reviewFindings.title: 105 将 exact Run retry 扩入 E1，但没有 formal scope authority
reviewFindings.problem: 107 已把 exact retry、OpenSpec projection 与 Windows cancellation 写入 Delivery Manifest 和 Explore，但没有产生可接纳的独立 Owner scope authority。Manifest ownerDecisions 对 E1 仍只有原 activate-change；没有 E1 contract-reset、scope 或 requiredOutcomes。107 context.ownerFactRefs 也为空。Author result 中“Owner 明确授权扩展”的陈述和普通 Manifest mutation 都不能创造 Owner authority，且 107 正是原 finding 要求在选择扩 scope 时停止 Author revision、先取得正式 Owner fact 的反例。因此扩展后的 target bytes 尚不能批准。
reviewFindings.contractRef: openspec/delivery-groups/20260810-01-change-execution-loop.yaml E1 goal/outputs and ownerDecisions; openspec/specs/flowkit-lean-run-and-action-package/spec.md bounded dual-entry preparation; AGENTS.md Owner Authority / Write-side
reviewFindings.invariant: Active Change 的 implementation/review scope 必须来自正式 Change/Delivery contract 或 Owner 独立明确的 contract reset；非权威参考、Author Explore 和 activation fact都不能自行扩大冻结 scope。
evidence: Current Manifest expands Delivery scope, E1 goal/outputs, verification plan and acceptance, but ownerDecisions adds only owner:7935d82c... decision=activate-change
No contract-reset for change-verification-selection-and-change-set exists in the current Manifest, and 107 context.json persists ownerFactRefs=[]
CodeGraph: collectApplicableOwnerFactRefs projects only decision=contract-reset with matching deliveryId/changeId plus scope and requiredOutcomes; activate-change is not a scope authority
CodeGraph: recordOwnerDecision requires contract-reset to carry changeId, scope and non-empty requiredOutcomes, preserving distinct provenance from activation

106 requiredOutcome explicitly required Author to stop and obtain a separate explicit formal scope/reset decision if Owner intended expansion; 107 instead completed revise-explore while claiming the absent authority
Independent verification: 107 produced Explore ref and source Review ref exact-match; 84 focused tests passed; formal text hygiene and git diff --check passed
reviewFindings.impact: Accepting 107 would authorize a material Delivery/Change scope rewrite through Author prose and unsigned Manifest bytes, bypassing the repository’s Owner-provenance and generation-reset boundary.
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Owner must independently decide whether E1 is expanded. If approved, materialize that exact E1 scope/reset through the current official Owner write-side with matching changeId, scope and requiredOutcomes, then let Policy recompute the boundary; unchanged target bytes may receive an explicit same-stage re-review after the new fact. If not approved, Owner must direct rollback/restart to the checkpoint-scoped E1 contract. Author must STOP and must not create another revise-explore to retroactively manufacture the authority.
acceptance: A new independently sourced formal Owner fact exactly identifies E1, the expanded scope and required outcomes, or Owner explicitly directs rollback to the frozen scope.
The authority is recorded through the official write-side and appears in the applicable formal Owner fact projection; activation alone is not reused as scope authorization.
No Author no-op revision or prose claim is used to close the authority blocker.

reviewFindings.title: 107 对 G1 剩余职责的声明与正式 Manifest 冲突
reviewFindings.problem: Explore Section 9 声明后续 G1 只收口 phase timing diagnostics 与 Change CLI performance budget，并明确 G1 不再拥有 retry、projection、cancellation 或 verification selection implementation。但当前 Manifest 的 G1 goal/outputs 未随 107 scope materialization 调整，仍正式拥有 Change CLI surface、Change E2E matrix、checkout/resume recovery、Action Package/Run size observation、focused/affected verification timing observation 和 review convergence observation。因而 E1/G1 对 resume/recovery 与 CLI/E2E 的 ownership boundary 仍有冲突，Proposal 无法判断哪些 production surface 和 acceptance 应在 E1 实现。
reviewFindings.invariant: 相邻 Change 的正式 scope/outputs 与当前 Explore 的范围分界必须一致且可唯一执行；当前 Change 不得以 Author artifact 静默缩减或重写 planned Change 的 formal ownership。
evidence: explore.md Section 9 says G1 only closes phase timing diagnostics and Change CLI performance budget
Manifest G1 still lists Change CLI surface, Change E2E matrix, checkout/resume recovery, Action Package/Run size observation, focused/affected timing and review convergence outputs
Manifest G1 goal still requires Change CLI, resume-context, full Change E2E and deterministic recovery to checkpoint boundary
107 Manifest diff expands E1 but does not modify the G1 record, so the claimed boundary is not materialized in the formal Delivery decomposition
reviewFindings.impact: Without one coherent boundary, E1 may absorb G1 implementation or omit required E1 primitives while both Changes claim recovery/CLI outcomes, making later acceptance and verification non-deterministic.
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: After the Owner scope decision is formally resolved, align Explore Section 9 with the actual Manifest G1 contract. Preserve G1 ownership of its existing CLI/E2E/checkout-resume/observation outputs unless Owner separately changes that formal scope; define E1 only as the underlying exact-retry/projection/cancellation primitives consumed by G1, with an explicit non-overlapping implementation-versus-E2E boundary.
acceptance: Explore and Manifest name the same G1 outputs and do not claim G1 has been reduced when its formal record remains unchanged.
E1 primitive implementation and G1 CLI/E2E/checkout-recovery verification ownership are separated without overlap or omission.
Proposal preflight can map every retry, projection, cancellation, CLI and recovery acceptance to exactly one Change-owned deliverable.
